title: Michel B NDE 4544/944
content:
4544 Translated to English by Kathy. My NDE – Brain hemorrhage as a result of a stroke. I began answering the NDERF questionnaire on February 25, 2004, some 3 years and a few months after my hemorrhagic stroke, which happened in late October 2000. I had nearly immediate coma, surgery, resuscitation and awakening 3 weeks later. Now, in 2010 I am changing nothing to my account. Hemorrhagic Stroke occurred during the night of the 28th to October 29, 2000, around 10:30 pm. I had a feeling of discomfort while answering the telephone and an almost immediate loss of consciousness, a feeling of dizziness and the inability to speak. I mumbled a few incomprehensible words to my wife, and made some uncontrolled movements on my left side. My wife called for help (I ‘perceived’ her call). I saw a black hole. I ‘saw’ the firefighters arrive in my room. I saw a definite black hole. I underwent immediate surgery and then about three weeks in a coma during which I was on a ventilator and was given different drugs. During this time, I had a few problems with oxygen deprivation (causing hypoxia / hypercapnia (?). It may be at this time that I had my experience(s). My condition at the time of the experience was Clinical death (Cessation of respiratory, heart and brain function). I was on a respirator for 3 weeks. I don't know if I was out of body, but I had the impression of lying on a very soft, warm substance (my mattress?); it was maybe a feeling of floating. I was looking downwards, arms held close to the body. I was very, very comfortable in this extended position. I was watching as a stranger (dispassionately) the scene unfolding about 50 meters away from me. At no time did I sense fear about what was going on outside. I was at peace, totally inaccessible; a simple observer, up high but not ‘flying’. I could see both my body and the outdoors. I could see myself ‘seeing’ (very difficult to explain). I could feel no pain. I was very, very comfortable, totally relaxed, bathed in softness and light. The feeling was of light, softness, peace and an absence of fear. It is all extraordinarily difficult to describe. I saw a stranger, perhaps a nurse, or doctor, dressed in a white shirt. There was a sense of tremendous brightness, but not dazzling, to my left. The scene was taking place in the morning, quite early, and I thought I could see a radiant sun illuminating everything. I could see the scene through what I believed to be the bay window in my room. The angle was very important every time I was looking down from above on this person dressed in a white shirt covering the arms all the way to the fingers. The legs were also covered to the tips of the toes. What is notable is the luminosity that enveloped everything and the impression of peace and tranquility. The first time: The person, quite young, dark hair, stethoscope around the neck, white shirt (classic image of a doctor) very sympathetic, holding his head in his hands, is saying, ‘but it’s not possible.’ Strangely, there was no indication of worry about him. It was a strange contradiction between what he was saying and the look on his face. I could clearly hear everything that was being said despite the relative distance between the glass separating us. The second time: It was the same scene that I was observing ‘from above and without emotion’, a person (the same?) still dressed in white on the telephone saying, and ‘The first time he had one chance in a hundred of pulling through the second time, one in a thousand’. The person still had the same youthful look and I could hear perfectly clearly despite the distance (The bay window was not an obstacle) (hyper acoustics?). The sky was still exceptionally luminous but never dazzling. Each time the ‘person’ was sitting on the steps, (very clean and brilliant). The stairway had about 15 steps and led to a great hall (glass doors reflecting the sun). The hall seemed to lead to or contain something darker, but not threatening, (difficult to describe) This scenery seemed to be a type of garden or prairie, very well groomed (very green grass cut short, white and yellow flowers with very luminous colors) Absolutely nothing out of place, the impression of a great cleanliness and of life. There were no faded flowers or dead branches. This whole landscape was bathed in light, which is difficult to describe correctly. According to my later research, I believe this is something close to the Garden of Eden. I observed the scene as a stranger, with no particular emotion, except maybe the joy of being there. I was totally at peace.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes hémorragie artère cérébale antérieure droite 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' There were serious consequences of my stroke. The surgeons had told my wife, 'He has a good heart, good lungs, good kidneys but he’s had it.' | Yes État de santé après l’expérience: hémiplégi gauche, perte de sensibilité profonde gauche, hyperesthésie cutanée gauche, hémianopsie latérale homonyme gauch, négligence gauche corrigée par la suite État de santé actuel: pas de changement par rapport à l' Clinical death je ne sais pas exactement, mais je suis resté trois semaines sous respirateurHemorrhagic cerebrovascular accident (probably due to high blood pressure /HBP) happened in the night of 29th to 30th October 2000, around 10 PM Operation, then about three weeks in coma, during this time I have been on respirator and had different drugs, and I lived my experience(s).
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain I lost awareness of my body | No
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I never had the impression of losing control.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I never had the impression of losing control. | Very serious after effects of operation (The resuscitator team 'nicely' averted my wife: ' Your husband has a good heart, good lungs, good kidneys, but he's damned'?)
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning | No
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I had the impression of exceptional brightness, but never dazzling.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Maybe, hyper-hearing? I could clearly understand a conversation taking place 50 meters away.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Uncertain I had the impression of being enveloped by a light that was sexually attractive. | No
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A being in white, who communicated nothing to me.
elements.The experience included: Light | Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes Very bright light, not dazzling and very attractive. | Yes The sky was very bright for the season. I thought being in spring or summer, during a beautiful morning, (while we were October or November, I don't know exactly).
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm J'avais l'impression d'observer un jardin d'Eden. | No
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Great happiness of being there. | None, I fully paid attention to what was said around me, but without apparent emotion.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future | No
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will | No
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes | Yes I tried to find signs of NDE on the net, but none of them correspond to my own experience.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes After a few years I started sharing my experience. | No
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Uncertain Since my experience I have being doing research on the Net. I will also share my NDE with a young woman who had this experience after a traffic accident.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No | No I'm not using any psychodysleptic substances and I never tried to reproduce this experience.
elements.Did your hearing differ in any way from: No, just a conversation between the figure and an unknown speaker.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: This experience is inexpressible, as at no time I felt it to be strange, or dreamlike or otherwise.
